projects.title: MILL Coffee & Roasters
projects.summary: One clean emblem that tells a specialty roastery’s story, from mountain origin to Baltic coast.
projects.problem: A specialty roastery by the Baltic coast with origins in the high mountains, but no mark that told that story.
projects.process: I joined two places in one clean circle: the Andes peaks over the Baltic horizon. Built in four versions (symbol, horizontal, vertical, name only) with a coast-inspired palette: coal, sand, quartz and Baltic blue.
projects.result: One emblem that tells the story from origin to roast. Readable down to 16 px or 8 mm, and works on bags, mugs, thermoses and walls.
projects.coverAlt: Black MILL coffee bag with the new mountain-and-horizon logo

images.alt: MILL symbol: mountain peaks over the Baltic horizon
MILL logo sheet with all versions, colours and font

projects.title: BB Factory
projects.summary: An apothecary mark for natural cosmetics, built to stay readable on a 5 ml dropper bottle.
projects.problem: Latvia’s leading natural-cosmetics supplier needed a mark that works on its smallest product, a 5 ml dropper bottle.
projects.process: I merged the letter B with a molecular structure for a clean apothecary feel, and tested it on 20–30 mm labels.
projects.result: A one-colour mark that stays readable at 6 mm or 16 px, with four versions for labels, lids, the online shop and the shop sign.
projects.coverAlt: BB Factory dropper bottles and jar with the new B logo

images.alt: BB Factory molecule B symbol on green
BB Factory logo sheet with all versions, colours and fonts
BB Factory online shop on two phones

projects.title: Brenguļu alus
projects.summary: A Modern Heritage label series for a cult brewery brewing since 1969.
projects.problem: A cult brewery brewing since 1969 in an old riverside mill, with a heritage the label didn’t fully show.
projects.process: A Modern Heritage style: strong typography, a “Since 1969” seal and clear colour coding for Light and Dark.
projects.result: Front label (90×105 mm) and neck label (80×30 mm) for both beers, print-ready. It honours the tradition without looking dated.
projects.coverAlt: Light and dark Brenguļu alus bottles with the new labels

images.alt: Flat Gaišais and Tumšais front labels
Close-up of the Since 1969 seal and wordmark

projects.title: Dabas Pieskāriens
projects.summary: A calm label system that lets a natural scrub be the hero of its own jar.
projects.problem: A natural skincare brand loved for its real petals and clays, but the label didn’t let the product speak.
projects.process: I sorted the information into a calm, clear order and added a single botanical line as the only decoration.
projects.result: A label system with front, back and lid. In the clear jar, the scrub itself becomes the main visual.
projects.coverAlt: Dabas Pieskāriens scrub jar with the new label

images.alt: Two jar versions with lid stickers
Close-up of the Miers & Harmonija label

items.question: How does the concept preview work?
items.answer: Within 48 hours you get two tailored directions presented on real mockups. You only pay if you choose to move forward.

items.question: How long does a full project take?
items.answer: Most logos and labels take 1–2 weeks after you pick a direction; a full packaging range or several products can take 3–4 weeks. Every project depends on its scope, so you get a fixed timeline together with your quote.

items.question: Do you handle printing?
items.answer: I don't print myself, but I prepare print-ready files to your printer's exact template and specifications, so they can print straight away.
